recipe.visualDefinition: A digital illustration featuring three stylized female characters in dynamic poses, set against a soft, gradient background. The characters are dressed in white and gold, with flowing hair and energetic expressions. Large, prominent typography for the title 'K-POP DEMON HUNTERS' is placed in the lower half, with a smaller subtitle below. The overall aesthetic is vibrant and modern, with a focus on character design and a clean, open composition.
coreVisualRelationships: Three central figures are arranged in a diagonal line, creating a sense of movement from left to right.
The large title typography acts as a strong base for the composition, grounding the figures above.
The soft, ethereal background contrasts with the sharp details and vibrant colors of the characters and text.
The characters' upward gaze and dynamic poses direct attention towards the upper part of the image, while the text anchors the bottom.
coreInvariants: Three stylized female characters in dynamic, energetic poses.
Characters wear white and gold outfits with intricate details.
Soft, gradient background transitioning from light blue to purple/pink.
Large, prominent title typography with a metallic/iridescent effect.
Smaller, sans-serif subtitle text below the main title.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The three female characters occupy the upper two-thirds of the image, with the central figure slightly larger and positioned higher. They are scaled to be the dominant visual elements.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large 'K-POP DEMON HUNTERS' title acts as the primary visual anchor, providing a stable base for the more dynamic figures above.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye is drawn from the left character, up to the central figure, and then to the right character, following the diagonal arrangement. The upward gaze of the characters and the upward-pointing elements in the typography (like the 'A' in K-POP) create an aspirational feel. The text then guides the eye across the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space in the upper background, a soft gradient, allows the characters and text to stand out without feeling cluttered. The space around the characters emphasizes their movement and individual forms.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Soft pastel gradients of blue, pink, and purple in the background provide a dreamy, ethereal base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: The white and gold of the characters' outfits, along with their vibrant hair colors (purple, black, magenta), provide strong contrast against the pastel background.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: The iridescent blue/purple sheen on the main title typography and the subtle glow effects serve as accents, adding a futuristic and magical touch.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: The background is low saturation and high value, creating a light and airy feel. The characters and text feature higher saturation and a wider range of values, making them pop against the background.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain a pastel gradient for the background.
Limit character outfits to white, gold, and iridescent accents.
Use vibrant, distinct colors for character hair.
Ensure the main title text has a metallic or iridescent quality.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: A sans-serif typeface with a geometric or slightly condensed structure, featuring sharp angles and a modern feel.
letterConstructionRules: Stroke endings are sharp and angular.
Some letterforms incorporate diamond or star-like cutouts/details (e.g., 'O', 'A').
Letters have an iridescent or metallic gradient fill, transitioning from light blue to purple/pink.
Letters have a subtle glow or outline effect.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'O' in 'K-POP' and 'DEMON' features a diamond-shaped cutout.
The 'A' in 'K-POP' and 'HUNTERS' has a pointed apex.
The 'P' in 'K-POP' has a sharp, angular counter.
The 'S' in 'HUNTERS' has a distinctive, almost crystalline form.

typesetting.leading: tight between lines of the same word, looser between words

composition.position: bottom center, spanning most of the width
composition.relationshipToImage: positioned below the characters, acting as a base

composition.position: below the main title, center aligned
composition.scale: small, approximately 1/5th the height of the main title

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A highly stylized, custom-modified display font for the main title paired with a clean, legible sans-serif for the subtitle to provide contrast and readability.

preserve: Sharp, angular terminals and corners for the main title.
Iridescent or metallic gradient fill for the main title.
avoid: Rounded letterforms for the main title.
Solid, flat colors for the main title.

candidateDirections.reason: Geometric sans-serif with a modern feel, good base for angular modifications and custom cutouts.
Clean, geometric structure that can be customized with sharp angles and internal details.
Futuristic and angular, providing a strong starting point for the display text's aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an image with three stylized female characters in dynamic poses, wearing white and gold outfits with intricate details. Place them against a soft, ethereal gradient background transitioning from light blue at the top to purple/pink at the bottom. Ensure ample space at the bottom for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Overlay the main title 'K-POP DEMON HUNTERS' in a large, bold, uppercase, geometric sans-serif font with sharp angles and custom diamond/star cutouts (e.g., in 'O', 'A'). Apply an iridescent gradient fill (light blue to purple/pink) and a subtle glow. Below this, add the subtitle 'SOUNDTRACK FROM THE NETFLIX FILM' in a smaller, uppercase, clean sans-serif font with loose tracking, in white. Both text blocks should be center-aligned.

verificationChecks: Are the three characters clearly visible and in dynamic poses?
Is the background a smooth, light pastel gradient?
Does the main title text have an iridescent/metallic effect and custom angular details?
Is the subtitle text clean, legible, and correctly positioned?
Is the overall composition balanced with characters above and text below?

adjustableVariables: Specific hues within the pastel background gradient.
Exact poses and expressions of the characters.
Details of the characters' outfits (while maintaining white/gold theme).
Specific iridescent color shift for the main title text.
Tracking and leading adjustments for the subtitle.
mustRedesign: Any text that is not uppercase.
Any text that uses a serif or script font.
A background that is not a soft, ethereal gradient.
Characters that are not stylized or lack dynamic poses.
Main title text without an iridescent or metallic effect.

mustAchieve: A vibrant and energetic overall mood.
Clear distinction between the characters and the background.
High legibility of all text elements.
A modern and slightly futuristic aesthetic.
avoid: Hard edges or abrupt transitions in the background gradient.

postGenerationChecks: Does the image convey a sense of energy and excitement?
Are the characters visually appealing and consistent in style?
Is the main title text impactful and visually interesting?
Is the subtitle easily readable despite its smaller size?
Does the overall color scheme feel cohesive and vibrant?
Are there any unintended artifacts or distortions in the text or characters?
recipe.reuseFormula: Recreate the scene with three stylized female characters in dynamic, energetic poses, dressed in white and gold, against a soft, pastel gradient background (light blue to purple/pink). Overlay a large, custom-modified geometric sans-serif title 'K-POP DEMON HUNTERS' with an iridescent gradient fill and angular details. Below it, add a smaller, uppercase, loosely tracked sans-serif subtitle 'SOUNDTRACK FROM THE NETFLIX FILM' in white. Ensure center alignment for all text and a clean, modern aesthetic.
